carrier and pointer domains.finding: 24 S4-labelled carrier modes and six persistent scalar record modes. No A4 x Bool code, finite Boolean pointer, or invariant embedding is supplied.

existing primitive Hamiltonians and allo.finding: Six addressed difference-mode pulses S_e(theta)=I+(exp(-i theta)-1)d_e d_e^T. Arbitrary pulse areas enlarge the tested submodel conservatively; arbitrary joint unitaries, controlled reflections, Kerr interactions and adaptive gates are not supplied.

preparation and readout.finding: Vacuum/coherent preparation and phase-referenced homodyne with a reference trial. Pointer record means are continuous noisy quantities, not an exact Boolean instrument or nondemolition encoder.

auxiliaries and return/reset.finding: Persistent record modes and reversible ideal pulse histories are specified; a Boolean recording apparatus with controller/bath return and reset resources is not.

timing and accuracy.finding: Pulse area selects the ideal operation, not duration or frequency. Prior detector work supplies conditional population moments and calibration failure controls, not a uniform finite-word implementation error bound.

source provenance of each assumption.finding: Bosonic mechanics, counting-normalized transition features, coherent preparation, supermode controls and phase reference are supplied. They are not derived from native query retention.

relation to A4 x Bool.finding: Agreement of some S4/A4 feature overlaps is not an operation-preserving code map. Every six-pulse word acts trivially on a common 24-dimensional subspace of the 30-mode amplitude space; it cannot intertwine the native triangle on its 24-dimensional joint label representation.

missing interfaces and obstructions.finding: Missing code/decoder, controlled Boolean recorder, uniform error contract and resource-return instrument. Direct faithful linear amplitude or single-excitation compilation is excluded by a rank invariant; arbitrary Fock-space/nonlinear/measurement-assisted encodings are not excluded.

scoped_no_go.allowed_dynamics: Finite words in the six documented passive pulses at arbitrary angles; optional common global phase does not remove the obstruction.
scoped_no_go.encoding_class: Injective linear map J:R^24 (or C^24) -> R^30 (or C^30), intertwining the native triangle L_ABC tensor I with a pulse word, without quotienting data.
scoped_no_go.pulse_invariant: The six independent difference directions span at most six dimensions. Every pulse word fixes their common orthogonal complement pointwise, so rank(U-I)<=6.
scoped_no_go.target: L_ABC tensor I has eight disjoint three-cycles, hence rank(L-I)=16. For any scalar z, rank(L-zI)>=16 over C.
scoped_no_go.contradiction: UJ=JL implies rank(J(L-I))=16 <= rank(U-I)<=6. A common phase gives the same contradiction with L-zI.
scoped_no_go.not_claimed: No universal physical no-go, no exclusion of nonlinear or multiparticle encodings, and no permission to add controls after this failure.
